crossContextFallbackInventory.behaviorOwner: Discovery owns item-detail rendering and fallback admission; Marketplace owns seller listing source reads.
crossContextFallbackInventory.actorOwnershipGuard: The fallback runs only for a signed-in actor with listings.view and listings.manage, and the Marketplace seller listing source row must belong to the same actor account before Discovery appends it.
crossContextFallbackInventory.catalogSourceGuard: The item-detail URL must be market=sell with a selected listing id and a valid Marketplace listing publish/update item-detail post-write handoff; the Marketplace seller listing must have the selected id, draft/active/paused status, and catalog_catalog_item_id matching the Discovery item catalog_item_id.
crossContextFallbackInventory.freshnessScope: A same-actor Marketplace listing publish/update redirect may recover the selected seller listing while discovery-market-projection catches up to discovery_market_listings for that listing.
crossContextFallbackInventory.terminationRule: Discovery reads its item-detail projection first and bypasses the fallback when the selected listing is already present. The fallback stops on missing/expired/malformed/non-Marketplace fresh-write receipts, missing item-detail handoff, non-sell market, missing selected listing id, missing listing permissions, wrong actor, wrong catalog item, unsupported listing status, permanent Marketplace failure, or the bounded Marketplace retry branch completing without a safe listing.
crossContextFallbackInventory.observability: The route emits no fallback logs or telemetry today. Any future fallback metric must use bounded labels such as context=discovery, surface=item-detail, strategy=fresh-read, route_id=item-detail, recovery_action=selected-seller-listing-fallback, and freshness_outcome only; never include raw receipts, account ids, listing ids, item ids, or full URLs.

visibleDestination.description: Google Shopping operator writes return durable job or maintenance summary snapshots. The admin route redirects with job ids or maintenance totals from the command response and the page renders those notices while progress is corrected by the durable job event stream.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The sync, maintenance, and diagnostics POST handlers return toGoogleShoppingFullSyncJobStatus snapshots or an exact maintenance summary directly from the command that queued the work; no operator success notice depends on a projected feed-row reload.

visibleDestination.description: Product Alert APIs return command-owned alert or anonymous-intent snapshots. Item detail and account Product Alert actions redirect with either the committed snapshot, a claim intent id, or bounded recovery copy rather than reading a just-written projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Product Alert create, claim, pause, resume, and delete responses include the committed id/version/status or anonymous-intent snapshot from the Discovery command; item-detail tests cover guest save, signed-in claim, and recovery paths.

visibleDestination.description: Search bulk add and Add to List stay on the browse page and render command-owned Checkout or Collections snapshots. Client-side request keys suppress stale snapshots when the visible Result Set or Product changes before the POST resolves.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The route action returns the Discovery preview plus Checkout bulk counts or the Collections Saved List aggregate snapshot from the owning command response.
proof.correction: The Search route records active Result Set and Product keys with request ids, applies only the latest matching response, and ignores older snapshots after navigation, selection, or filter changes.

visibleDestination.description: Item-detail writes that navigate to Checkout, Sell List, Sales, or back to Item Detail preserve the command owner's receipt in afterWrite when the destination is projection-backed. Add to List stays on item detail and renders the Collections command snapshot; guest checkout readiness and Saved List registration carry durable command or intent state instead of relying on a fresh Discovery projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The Discovery action consumes Checkout, Marketplace, Inventory, Discovery, or Collections command snapshots in the same request. Add to List returns the Saved List aggregate snapshot in place; navigations carry their owner receipt and destination owners govern any actual fresh-read waits.

visibleDestination.description: The item-detail add-to-cart fetcher remains on the Detail Page and returns the committed Checkout cart-line id, version, status, item title, and quantity so the cart count and success notice do not depend on a stale cart projection. The success notice's View cart link carries the same Checkout command receipt as an afterWrite fresh-write token plus the Checkout-owned semantic add-line post-write handoff (viewCartHref), so /account/cart can treat signed-in or anonymous empty reads as pending only for this add-line intent while remove-to-empty or normal visits keep the ordinary empty-cart state.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The Discovery route action copies the Checkout addCartLine/addGuestCartLine command snapshot into the fetcher JSON response and the UI reconciles the visible success state from that response. The same Checkout command result is threaded through appendPostWriteHandoff with the Checkout-owned add-line handoff constant to build viewCartHref, so the View cart link to /account/cart preserves the command owner's receipt and semantic add-line expectation; the Checkout account cart loader owns the actual fresh-read wait and pending/empty distinction for that destination.

visibleDestination.description: The public listing report form posts to the Discovery-owned route action, which receives Marketplace's report submission snapshot and redirects back with a reported marker instead of waiting on a projection.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Marketplace Report Listing returns id, version, target, report count, threshold, and auto-unlisted directly from the command result.

visibleDestination.description: The public account Review report action returns Marketplace's command-owned submitted or already-submitted status inline. It does not wait on Discovery's public account projection and does not remove or alter the visible Review.

proof.authoritativeResponse: Marketplace Report Review returns the report id, version, target, and status directly from the report command; duplicate stream state maps to an explicit already-submitted result.
